title: File System Activity event (attachment, dropped-file and encryption-window telemetry)
summary: OCSF File System Activity events on two triage surfaces: phishing_triage consumes them for attachment evaluation (sandbox verdicts, hash reputation) and, in the malware-attached branch, endpoint observations of artifacts written by a clicked attachment so the endpoint-isolation step can be scoped to affected hosts; ransomware_containment consumes them at triage (mass rename / write / delete surrounding the encryption window) and at backup verification (snapshot-catalogue file-state records). The upstream class name is `file_activity` (uid 1001) — its caption is File System Activity, and a ransomware overlay briefly referenced it under the caption-derived name `file_system_activity`; provenance on issue #875.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 System Activity category — File System Activity class (uid 1001)
